domains.title: HVAC Fundamentals
domains.gap: Practice covers tools and isolation. Science, construction and code study need additional resources.

domains.title: Electrical and Controls
domains.gap: Selected single-phase equipment only. Three-phase systems, field wiring installation and advanced electronics are not covered.

domains.title: Comfort and Airflow
domains.gap: Practice covers temperature rise and restrictions. Humidity, psychrometrics, static-pressure testing and air balancing are not covered.

domains.title: Installation
domains.gap: Practice covers selected refrigerant service steps. Equipment installation, duct fabrication and commissioning are not comprehensively covered.

domains.title: Service
domains.gap: Selected residential faults only. This is not complete coverage of the service exam.

skills.label: Tools and safe isolation
skills.objective: Select instruments, isolate equipment and verify conditions before repair.

skills.label: Meters and component tests
skills.objective: Use voltage, current, resistance and capacitance readings to distinguish failed loads from supply faults.

skills.label: Control circuits and sequences
skills.objective: Trace a call through low-voltage controls, safety switches and equipment outputs.

skills.label: Temperature rise and restrictions
skills.objective: Compare supply and return temperatures and distinguish restricted airflow from a blower start fault.

skills.label: Evacuation and charging
skills.objective: Practice recovery, regulated nitrogen testing, evacuation with a standing test and charging by weight.

skills.label: Residential fault diagnosis
skills.objective: Use measured evidence to choose a repair and verify restored heating or cooling.
